note: Edit this file to add, reorder or hide projects. show:false hides a card. group is 'product' or 'creative'. Images live in assets/projects/.

projects.title: UCAS Student Planner
projects.line: Key dates and next actions for a UCAS application, in one place a student will actually open.
projects.why: Admissions data turned into plain next steps for the person applying.

projects.title: UCAS Key Dates Dashboard
projects.line: UCAS undergraduate key dates from 2022 to 2026 on one timeline, with phase tracking, a matrix view and calendar export.
projects.why: Built for admissions and planning teams who need the whole cycle at a glance.

projects.title: Word Craft
projects.line: Turns the words you notice into words you can use: capture, review and practise saying them.
projects.why: A learning tool I wanted for myself, built with React and TypeScript.

projects.title: Birds Watch
projects.line: A location-aware bird atlas: which birds have been recorded near you, and when, from your street to the whole planet.
projects.why: Open biodiversity records made readable on a map and a timeline.

projects.title: Kaleido
projects.line: A pocketful of wonder: a kaleidoscope you can relax with, draw in or explore.

projects.title: FluxPixel Studio
projects.line: One app, three particle playgrounds: Studio, Nebula and a 3D engine.
projects.why: Particle systems tuned by hand until they felt right.

projects.title: Aurora
projects.line: Strength of Symmetry: mirrors, spirals and symmetry presets that build patterns as you move.
projects.why: A study in how simple rules produce rich structure.

projects.title: Fluid Canvas Studio
projects.line: Drag to stir the fluid. A real-time vortex simulation you can play with.
projects.why: Fluid physics in WebGL, made touchable.

projects.title: Solar System
projects.line: The planets in orbit on a single canvas.
projects.why: An early canvas experiment that started the rest.

projects.title: Nebula Fireworks
projects.line: Fireworks you can tune: size, speed and colour, then detonate.
